contents.text: How much stock-based compensation expense did Microsoft record in fiscal year 2026?

Microsoft recorded $12,405 million in stock-based compensation expense for the year ended June 30, 2026. (Source: MSFT-10K-2026.html, PART II > Item 8. FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AND SUPPLEMENTARY DATA > Employee Stock and Savings Plans)
